versions.subject: Merge PR #4983 from @swachchhanda000 - Add `Task Scheduler DLL Loaded By Application Located In Potentially Suspicious Location`
versions.detection:
selection_dll:
    - ImageLoaded|endswith: '\taskschd.dll'
    - OriginalFileName: 'taskschd.dll'
selection_paths:
    Image|contains:
        - ':\Temp\'
        - ':\Users\Public\'
        - ':\Windows\Temp\'
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - '\Desktop\'
        - '\Downloads\'
condition: all of selection_*
